faq.title: Get to know Spaces deeper.
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions before creating your team workspace.
faq.a1: Spaces is a collaborative digital workspace combining task management, daily agendas, and team documentation within a serene, distraction-free environment. We prioritize tranquility and the elimination of cognitive clutter prevalent in conventional productivity suites.
faq.q2: What kind of teams is Spaces designed for?
faq.a2: Spaces is designed for creative studios, software houses, digital agencies, product teams, and independent craftspeople who value deep focus, calm communication, and transparency without endless notification barrages.
faq.q3: What are the core features in the initial release?
faq.a3: Core features include structured task management, personal & team daily agendas, collaborative notes, Pomodoro focus sessions with ambient music, automated quiet-hour scheduling, and multi-member role hierarchy.
faq.a4: You can define studio operating hours (e.g. 09:00 - 17:00). Outside these hours, incoming notifications are held silently and politely surfaced the next morning when your team resumes work.
faq.q5: Are light and dark themes available?
faq.a5: Yes! Spaces includes two signature palettes: Botanical Light (warm sage and botanical hues for daylight focus) and Midnight Calm (deep navy and gentle gold accents for evening work).
faq.q6: Is the AI Assistant available today?
faq.a6: The Mora AI Assistant is currently scheduled for release in Q2 2026 to assist with meeting minutes extraction, draft brainstorming, and automated agenda structuring.
